text.description_html:
Don-Jo 8" x 14" Brass Tone Aluminum Door Push Plate

Custom sized brass tone aluminum push plate. 8" wide x 14" high door push plate for residential or commercial use. Packaged with finish matched mounting screws for easy installation.

These custom push plates are made in the USA by Don-Jo Mfg.

Specifications of Don-Jo 8x14BT Brass Tone Aluminum Push Plate

  • Plate Width: 8"
  • Plate Height: 14"
  • Plate Thickness: .040"
  • Material: Solid Aluminum
  • Finish: Brass Tone
  • Packaged with finished matched mounting screws.

*Sold Individually.
